SCP-001.raw_content:
• VIDEO LOG

    [000:00:00]: (Ragged breathing.)

    [000:00:02]: (Camera rushes down a forested path at night. Footage is shaky.)

    [000:00:05]: (In a hushed voice) If— if you're watching this, then my worst fears will have come to pass.

    [000:00:07]

    [000:00:10]: My name is gone, something, some thing, took it from me when I ran. I swear █ ███ ███ ████ ██ █████ █████████ ████ ██ ██.1

    [000:00:16]: But I know those eyes can't possibly be my own.

    [000:00:19]: I saw the others too. Jason, Aaron, faces that are theirs but not at the same time.

    [000:00:25]: (Retching sound.)

    [000:00:27]: (The man travels the path in a clockwise direction.)

    [Footage continues uninterrupted for 4 minutes.]

    [000:04:23]: Right, I should at least leave some thing of worth for my successor. At least, I hope you're my successor. (Coughing.)

    [000:04:39]: Every time we mess with the rules of the world, it causes an echo that pools at the bottom of the… well? Lake? Monsters that always have been, patterns that screams illogic, people existing only in recollections and collective hallucination…

    [400:00:01]2

    [000:05:02]: (The man pauses.) I can't wash the entrails off of my hands.

    [000:05:05]: (Deep breaths.)

    [The man continues walking in the clockwise direction for 731 hours. Whether the man did not notice the passage of time or was steadfastly ignoring it is unknown.]

    [731:07:36]: Who are you?

    [731:07:39]

    [731:07:39]:

    [731:07:50]: You're not Agnes! We don't have an administrator!

    [731:08:00]:

    [731:08:14]:

    [731:08:32]: Of course I'm still me! I'm still—

    [731:08:35]: (Silence.)

    [731:08:39]: (The man sprints down the path, not looking back.)

    [906:45:47]: (The man continues to run.)

    [999:99:99]:[:20:32]: (There is a pond.)

    It is clean.
    Everett's Proposal

    One portion of SCP-001

    Item #: SCP-001

    Object Class: Embla

    Containment Procedures: SCP-001 is contained on the grounds of Site-51. A fence has been constructed around the perimeter of SCP-001's observed effects. A single armed guard patrols the area to prevent unauthorized entry. The adjoining laboratory has been padlocked.

    A small metal plaque will be left to wear out until its inscription is no longer readable.

    Description: SCP-001 is a circular gravel path in a wooded area. When traveled in a counter-clockwise direction, the trail is continuously uphill, even after reaching the original point. When traveled in a clockwise direction, the trail shows the same amount of uphill and downhill travel, by design.

    Bibliography
    1. Audio semantically obfuscated, unparseable.
    2. Resemblance to the man is considered coincidental.
    Footnotes
    1. Site-5 is not yet lost.
    The remainder of this file has been locked.
    Access denied.

    Keep up the good work, Everett. You will be here for a very long time.
